extra.summary: The Citi Prestige card is tailored for affluent individuals who prioritize travel. The included complimentary fourth night hotel stay can provide substantial value for frequent travelers planning longer trips. Enjoy complimentary benefits like limousine transfers and golf games. This card rewards high spenders comfortable with sizable annual fees in exchange for premium travel perks.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 1% plus 1% of any outstanding unbilled instalment amounts plus interest charges plus late payment charge or S$50, whichever is higher

our_takes.our-take: The Citi Prestige card is tailored for affluent individuals who prioritize travel. The included complimentary fourth night hotel stay can provide substantial value for frequent travelers planning longer trips. However, the high annual fee of S$545 (inclusive of GST) and foreign transaction fees of 3.25% warrant consideration. Cardholders should weigh these costs against the benefits like limousine transfers and golf games. This card rewards high spenders comfortable with sizable annual fees in exchange for premium travel perks.
our_takes.good-for:
High-income earners desiring premium travel benefits, such as complimentary hotel stays and airport transfers.
Affluent individuals who enjoy golfing and seek access to exclusive golf courses in Southeast Asia.
Well-heeled travelers who frequently make overseas purchases and want to earn accelerated miles on those transactions.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fees are S$545; consider if the card's benefits outweigh this significant yearly cost.
Interest rates are high, up to 30.9% if past due, making balances costly to carry.
Foreign transaction fees are 3.25% per transaction, increasing costs when using abroad.
